name: ALSCO Pooling Service Co., Ltd.
summary: ALSCO Pooling Service Co., Ltd. offers reusable packaging and shared rental services around the world, with products including the Sleeve Box, JET Box, BIGBox and SUPERBox plus car transport frames, backed by pooling, integrated logistics and digital management. Its customers are mainly in conventional and new energy vehicles and photovoltaics. Incorporated in 2016 in Suzhou, the company previously operated as Anwood Logistics Systems.
